description: Serial runtime against problem size: the benchmark problem on 4096 x 4096 cells of the 1 x 1 basin, 10 steps, run by the pure serial program on one core. experiments/serial_size_*.json differ only in the size and the steps (fewer on the large grids to keep the runs short); compare the time per CG iteration. The domain is fixed, so dx and the automatic dt shrink with the grid. The parallel entry is a placeholder: hpc/jobs/serial_sizes.pbs runs only the references (--run serial_reference).
